name: AP-7 Alicante–Cartagena
law: The Ministry of Transport's tolls in force from 2026-01-01 on the AP-7 Alicante–Cartagena, per barrier (Troncal de Los Montesinos, Acceso de La Zenia, Troncal de La Zenia): Pesados 1 (two or three axles) EUR 4.2149 and Pesados 2 (four axles or more) 5.3719 in the low season, 4.9174 and 5.9504 in the high season, excluding 21% IVA. High season: June to September and the 17 days of Semana Santa (from the Friday before it to the Sunday after it); regular users pay the low season's tolls all year (not modelled). Barriers placed at OpenStreetMap's toll plazas on the motorway, in the table's order from north to south.
